name: First Drop
brief: An empty dock and a straight run back onto Bay 3. There's a banksman on the bay to talk you in – watch him in your mirror.

tutorial.text: Welcome to the yard. Bay 3 is the green one behind you. Hold {reverse} to back up.
Watch the trailer, not the cab. To swing the back of the trailer left, steer right – and the other way round. Small inputs!
The banksman calls out steering: “left hand down” means steer left. If he blows his whistle – stop!
Trailer drifting off line? Steer towards the side it's drifting to, then centre the wheel as it comes back.
Nearly there. Ease off and touch the buffers at walking pace – under 2 mph.
All three checks are green. Stop and press {handbrake} to put the handbrake on.
That's a shunt. Pulling forward to straighten up is fine – but every shunt costs stars.
Contact! Each bump adds 5 seconds. Anything at 2.5 mph or more and it's game over.
